title: A cantilever's tip deflection
model: a 100 x 10 x 10 mm steel cantilever clamped at x = 0, 1 kN down on its free end, read at the end's centre; 2.5 mm elements

tip.source: Timoshenko beam: P L^3 / 3EI + P L / (k G A), k = 10(1 + nu)/(12 + 11 nu) (Cowper, J. Appl. Mech. 33 (1966) 335)
tip.reason: a beam theory is not the solid: the clamp holds the root's Poisson contraction and its warping, which the beam leaves free, and at L/h = 10 that stiffens the root by about a percent; the mesh error at 2.5 mm is a tenth of that
